Position Overview

Data Analyst - Entry Level (Remote). We are looking for the right people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform data engineering, data modeling and model deployment under general supervision.
• Analyze large scale complex business data (time series data, structured/unstructured) from various data sources and draw insights.
• Leverage common open-source Machine Learning/Deep Learning packages for identifying data patterns and/or building predictive models.
• Conduct statistical analysis to determine trends and significant data relationships.
• Keep up to date with the latest Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence advancements.
• Work with data engineers to design and construct data pipelines for reproducible analysis.
• Leverage cloud computing technologies like Microsoft Azure and distributed computing technologies like Apache Spark.
• Present results of analyses, including design of graphs, charts, tables, and other data visualizations.

Required Qualifications
• Industry experience in predictive modeling, data science and analysis.
• Knowledge of Machine Learning frameworks and packages, including Keras, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn and cloud computing platforms like Azure.
• Experience handling terabyte size datasets, diving into data to discover hidden patterns and using data visualization tools.
• Experience writing code in Python, R, Scala, and distributed computing technologies like Spark.
• Demonstrated teamwork, strong communication skills, and collaboration in complex engineering projects.
• Completion of an undergraduate degree in STEM.

Preferred Qualifications
• Master's degree in STEM is preferred.
• Candidates with qualifications exceeding the minimum requirements will be considered for higher level roles.

A tech company specializing in AI solutions is seeking an entry-level AI/ML Engineer to innovate and contribute to machine learning applications. This role requires a Master's or equivalent in AI, ML, or Data Science, along with proficiency in Python and various AI libraries. Key responsibilities include building and deploying AI models, collaborating with teams, and implementing model monitoring and optimization strategies. Join a pioneering team shaping the future of business intelligence through AI.

Position Overview

Position: Business Data Analyst, Construction. We are one of the leading mechanical contractors in the eastern United States. Our construction and service (mechanical and electrical) experience spans commercial and government projects including data centers, hospitals, sports stadiums, convention centers, hotels, and research laboratories. The Business Data Analyst assists the company in meeting its objectives by supporting management and providing analysis of business data for effective decision making and organizational efficiency improvement. Location: Baltimore, MD 21227. Reports to: Vice President. FLSA Status: Full-Time / Exempt. Work Shift: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. / Mon. – Fri.

Key Responsibilities
• Aggregates and performs statistical analysis on business data based on requests from project teams or senior leadership.
• Integrates data from multiple sources or functional areas, ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and updates data as needed.
• Writes queries or reports to provide data for various analytical projects and interprets data to identify business trends and conduct root cause analysis.
• Generates analytical and statistical information in various formats using advanced features of Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Power BI, and related software.
• Complies with all company operating policies, procedures, and safety programs as established.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, and/or a related field.
• One to three years of professional experience, including internship experience.
• Advanced experience in Microsoft Office Excel and Power BI applications.
• Familiarity with software applications utilized in data analytics for business.
• Must possess professional integrity and be trustworthy.
• Strong interpersonal communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Proven ability to organize and manage multiple projects.
• Ability to independently analyze and solve problems on both strategic and tactical levels.
• Commitment to company values.
• Effective communication, cooperation, and collaboration with employees, government agencies, contractors, vendors, and/or suppliers.

Note: The job is a remote job and is open to candidates in USA. High 5 Games is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) to design, build, and optimize their machine learning operations. The role involves scaling AI models from research to production, ensuring smooth model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure.

Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and solutions, leveraging tools such as LangGraph and MLflow for orchestration and lifecycle management
• Collaborate on building and maintaining scalable data and feature pipeline infrastructure for real time and batch processing using tools like BigQuery, BigTable, Dataflow, Composer(Airflow), PubSub, and Cloud Run to support ML model training and inference
• Develop and implement robust strategies for model monitoring and observability to detect model drift, bias, and performance degradation, leveraging tools like Vertex AI Model Monitoring and custom dashboards
• Optimize ML model inference performance to improve latency and cost-efficiency of AI applications
• Ensure the overall reliability, performance, and scalability of the ML models and data infrastructure platform, including proactive identification and resolution of issues related to model performance and data quality
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues impacting ML models, data pipelines, and production AI systems
• Ensure AI/ML models and workflows meet data governance, security, and compliance requirements, specifically for real-money gaming

Skills
• 1+ years of experience as an ML Engineer, with a focus on developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments
• Strong experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including services relevant to ML and data infrastructure such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub and Composer (Airflow)
• Solid grasp of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and experience with Kubernetes orchestration platforms like GKE for deploying ML services
• Experience building and deploying scalable data pipelines and machine learning models in production environments
• Understanding of model monitoring, logging, and observability best practices for ML models and applications
• Experience in Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
• Familiarity with AI orchestration concepts using tools like LangGraph or LangChain
• Bonus experience includes working in gaming, real-time fraud detection, or AI personalization systems and Agentic workflows

Company Overview
• High 5 Games is laser-focused on making an impression through innovative casino content for the land-based, mobile, online, and social markets. It was founded in 1995, and is headquartered in New York, New York, USA, with a workforce of 51-200 employees. Its website is http://www.high5games.com/.

Company H1B Sponsorship
• High 5 Games has a track record of offering H1B sponsorships, with 1 in 2024, 1 in 2022, 2 in 2021, 4 in 2020. Please note that this does not guarantee sponsorship for this specific role.

About the role

We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to help design, build, and deploy ML solutions. This role focuses on turning models into reliable systems and collaborating with engineering teams to operationalize ML.

What you will do
• Develop and train ML models with reproducible pipelines
• Build data preprocessing workflows and feature generation
• Deploy models to production and monitor performance
• Work with stakeholders to define success metrics and test outcomes
• Document experiments and contribute to best practices

What you are looking for
• Degree in CS, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
• Strong Python, data handling (pandas), and ML fundamentals
• Familiarity with scikit-learn and basic model evaluation
• Understanding of software engineering basics (Git, testing, modular code)

Nice to have
• PyTorch or TensorFlow
• Experience with ML pipelines, Airflow, or workflow orchestration
• Exposure to CI/CD, Docker, and cloud services

Job Description

Data-driven, intelligent systems can bring immense computing power to bear, revealing insights across datasets too massive for humans to synthesize. We help our customers to build and enable those systems by creating trusted data engineering architectures, machine learning algorithms, and analytic techniques that put the power of big data at our users' fingertips while leverage deep expertise in human decision-making and collaboration to best pair humans and machines.

As a recent graduate working in data science, operations research, math and statistics, you will work with a team to apply your knowledge and gain experience with one or more of the following:
• Data analysis and visualization
• Augmented decision making and trusted analytics
• AI architecture, strategy and policy
• AI-enhanced decision making and insights
• Generative AI and large language models
• Machine learning operations
• Applied math, statistics and optimization
• Simulation and computational analytics
• Systems modeling and analysis
• Operational effectiveness and efficiency
• Knowledge discovery
• Next-gen data environments

Basic Qualification
• Must have a Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Math, Statistics or a related degree/program
• Knowledge of how retrieve data from databases and other systems and tools using queries, exporting capabilities, and other effective methods
• Understanding of or experience with statistical software and data visualization tools such as R, SPSS, SAS, and UNIX shell scripting
• Sustained excellence in academic performance

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience having applied data science, artificial intelligence, math, statistics or a related learning to an internship or research/lab position.
• Experience retrieving data from databases and other systems and tools using queries, exporting capabilities, and other effective methods
• Experience with statistical software and data visualization tools such as R, SPSS, SAS, and UNIX shell scripting
• Proficiency in one or more of the following: Python (scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas, Jupyter), Scala/Java, C/C++/C#, Objective C; database design & development (SQL, Neo4J, MongoDB); AWS
• Demonstrated interest in serving the public
